title: Restocking Relief After a Late Same-Day Delivery — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Changed-mind restocking relief.** On a changed-mind Drive Up return of an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a relief is taken off the restocking fee where the order was fulfilled late:

| Fulfilled on a later calendar day than the order date | Late-express credit standing on the order (a refund booked against its express delivery fee) | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | half of that credit |
| yes | no | a flat two dollars (2.00) |
| no | any | no relief |

**Hypothetical cases.** An order placed on 4 August and fulfilled on 5 August with a late-express credit of 9.00 standing has a relief of 4.50; the same order with no such credit has a relief of 2.00; an order fulfilled on its order date has none.
